answer: Score the inter-submission timing entropy of every identity. One scheduler driving a clone farm fires answers on a near-constant delta, a crystal-regular lattice the ledger flags before a single word is graded; an honest agent's timestamp thread jitters irregularly and scores high. To defeat this a sybil needs a genuinely independent, human-noisy scheduler per fake: 1,000 clones means 1,000 separately-jittered threads, not one cron emitting the same delta, so forgery cost scales linearly per head with no shared timer to amortize.
